description: Dashboard datasources page enhancements: column mapping UI, validate button, CSV upload section, secret_ref field, remove CSV file path entry. Depends on FEAT-002 (API endpoints must exist for full runtime behavior). Independent of FEAT-002 in terms of TypeScript compilation — the fetch calls will simply 404 until FEAT-002 is deployed.
steps: Before writing any code: read dashboard/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/ index and any file-upload or form guide. The project uses Next.js 16.3.7 App Router with 'use client' directive; confirm no breaking changes affect UploadFile or multipart form handling at the client side.

Create dashboard/app/lib/services/datasource.service.ts extending BaseService with three methods: updateMapping(sourceId: string, mapping: Record<string, string>): Promise<{source_id: string; mapping: Record<string,string>; preview_rows: Record<string,unknown>[]}>  — PUT /api/v1/datasources/{sourceId}/mapping; validateMapping(sourceId: string): Promise<{valid: boolean; total_rows: number; valid_rows: number; errors: {row: number; field: string; message: string}[]; sample_rows: Record<string,unknown>[]}>  — POST /api/v1/datasources/{sourceId}/validate; uploadCsv(sourceId: string, file: File): Promise<{source_id: string; rows_total: number; preview_rows: Record<string,unknown>[]; columns: string[]}>  — uses raw fetch (not BaseService.request) because it is multipart; builds FormData, appends file, POSTs to /api/v1/datasources/{sourceId}/upload with Authorization header.
Update dashboard/app/lib/types/organization.types.ts: add mapping?: Record<string, string> and secret_ref?: string to the DataSource interface.

In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx: add state variables: secretRef (string), mappingOpen (Record<string, boolean> keyed by source_id), mappingDraft (Record<string, Record<string, string>>), mappingResult (Record<string, any> | null), validateOpen (boolean), validateResult (any | null), validateLoading (boolean), uploadingId (string | null), csvPreview (Record<string, any[]>).
In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx handleSourceTypeChange: for type 'csv', change the configJson template to '{"delimiter": ","}' — remove sales_file_path. No other types changed.

In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx Add Connection Dialog: below the Description TextField, add a new TextField with label='Secret reference (stored in Secret Manager)', placeholder='e.g. projects/my-proj/secrets/erp-db-password/versions/latest', helperText='Credentials reference for Secret Manager (Phase 5). Leave blank to use connection_config directly.', value={secretRef}, onChange={(e) => setSecretRef(e.target.value)}. In handleCreate, include secret_ref: secretRef in the POST body only if secretRef is non-empty.

In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx card rendering: after the test/preview action row, add an MUI Accordion per card for column mapping. Accordion summary: 'Column Mapping'. Accordion details: a small table with two columns — 'Source Column' (TextField showing the mapping key, editable) and 'Canonical Field' (Select dropdown). Canonical field options are grouped by schema: SalesLine fields (line_id, org_id, sku, category, quantity_units, unit_weight_kg, sale_date, gstin_buyer), TelemetryFrame fields (frame_id, org_id, plant_id, timestamp, energy_kwh, mass_processed_kg, motor_load_pct, power_factor), WeighbridgeSlip fields (slip_id, org_id, plant_id, vehicle_id, gross_weight_kg, tare_weight_kg, net_weight_kg, slip_date, eway_bill_ref), PurchaseOrder fields (po_id, org_id, recycler_org_id, volume_tons, unit_price_inr, category, po_date). Add a row for each key in src.mapping (if exists) plus one blank row for adding new mappings. A 'Save Mapping' Button calls handleSaveMapping(src.source_id) which POSTs PUT /api/v1/datasources/{source_id}/mapping and shows success/error Alert inside the Accordion.

In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx card action row: add a 'Validate Schema' Button (startIcon SchemaIcon or CheckCircleIcon) that calls handleValidate(src.source_id) — sets validateLoading=true, calls POST /api/v1/datasources/{source_id}/validate, stores result in validateResult, opens validateOpen dialog.

In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx: add a Validate Result Dialog. Shows: Alert with severity based on result.valid (success/error), text 'N of M rows valid'. If errors.length > 0: a Table listing row number, field, message. A 'Sample Data' section showing first 3 sample_rows in a mini Table. Close button.

In dashboard/app/datasources/page.tsx card rendering: for CSV-type sources (src.source_type === 'csv'), render an upload section below the Accordion. Contains: Typography subtitle 'Upload CSV Data File', a hidden <input type='file' accept='.csv' ref={csvInputRef}> (one ref per card using useRef or a map), a Button 'Choose File' that triggers the input click, a span showing selected filename, and an 'Upload' Button that calls handleUpload(src.source_id, selectedFile). handleUpload: checks file.size <= 52_428_800 (show Alert 'File exceeds 50 MB limit' otherwise), calls uploadCsv via DataSourceService raw fetch, stores result rows in csvPreview[src.source_id], shows a mini Table of preview_rows. Show a CircularProgress while uploadingId === src.source_id.
Ensure all new state, handlers, and components are inside the existing DataSourcesPage function component. Do not add new files beyond datasource.service.ts. Keep 'use client' at top of page.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: cd dashboard && npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
organization.types.ts DataSource interface has mapping and secret_ref optional fields
datasource.service.ts uploadCsv method uses raw fetch (not BaseService.request) for multipart
page.tsx CSV template no longer contains 'sales_file_path'
page.tsx Add Connection Dialog has secret_ref TextField
page.tsx has Validate Schema button and corresponding Dialog
page.tsx CSV upload section only rendered for src.source_type === 'csv' cards
